prs.cluster_pick_reason: 1996 introduces a standalone `acceptsMediaType()` helper that does proper per-entry Accept header parsing (splits on commas, strips parameters, and explicitly excludes entries with q=0), so it correctly rejects a client that sends `application/json;q=0` while still accepting bare `application/json`. 2046's inline fix (`acceptHeader?.includes('application/json')`) is a substring check that does not account for quality values or parameter-bearing media-type entries, so it can misclassify Accept headers that a stricter parser would reject. 1996 also isolates the parsing logic in a named, independently testable function rather than inlining more conditional logic into the existing request handler.

clusters.pick_reason: 2215 introduces a single shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper and updates every call site that depends on the trailing-slash/root convention, including shouldAttemptFallback's root-path comparison. #2214 applies the same regex fix inline in two places but never touches shouldAttemptFallback, so merging #2214 alone would still leave 'pathname === "/"' unmatched once paths are normalized, causing the redundant-fallback bug #2215 exists to fix. #2215 is a strict superset: it resolves the double-slash malformation #2214 targets and the extra fallback bug #2214 doesn't address.

members.title: chore(client): normalize trailing slashes in discovery paths
members.author: raashish1601
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2215: Both rewrite the trailing-slash stripping logic in buildWellKnownPath/buildDiscoveryUrls used to build OAuth/OIDC discovery URLs. #2214 replaces the single-slash '.endsWith("/")' strip with a greedy '/\/+$/' regex (fixing malformed paths with multiple trailing slashes, e.g. '/foo//.well-known/...'). #2215 makes the identical regex change via a new normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper, and additionally updates shouldAttemptFallback's root check from 'pathname === "/"' to 'pathname === ""' — a change only needed because normalizeDiscoveryPath now collapses a root '/' pathname to ''. Both PRs touch the exact same lines in buildWellKnownPath with functionally identical regex logic, so they will conflict on merge and are addressing the same root-pathname-normalization issue.
